svg.title: Sciver System Architecture
svg.desc: A long-horizon scientific workflow engine for judgment, process control, evidence traceability, and recovery

text.tspan: A long-horizon scientific workflow engine for judgment, process control, evidence traceability, and recovery
Defines long-term goals, boundaries, and current scientific understanding
Responsible for scientific judgment; does not directly mutate system state
Orchestrates contracts, commits, and recovery without replacing scientific judgment
SQLite is authoritative; Canvas and Web are projections or presentation layers
